def: Use <, >, ≤, or ≥ to show many numbers.
defEs: Usar <, >, ≤ o ≥ para mostrar muchos valores posibles.
alt: Illustration of Write Inequalities: Use <, >, ≤, or ≥ to show many numbers.

def: A math sentence that compares sides with <, >, ≤, or ≥.
defEs: Una oración matemática que compara lados con <, >, ≤ o ≥.
alt: Illustration of Inequality: A math sentence that compares sides with <, >, ≤, or ≥.

def: The > sign. It shows one number is bigger.
defEs: El signo >. Muestra que un número es mayor.
alt: Illustration of Greater than: The > sign. It shows one number is bigger.

def: The < sign. It shows one number is smaller.
defEs: El signo <. Muestra que un número es menor.
alt: Illustration of Less than: The < sign. It shows one number is smaller.

def: ≥ means that amount or more. ≤ means that amount or less.
defEs: ≥ significa esa cantidad o más. ≤ significa esa cantidad o menos.
alt: Illustration of At least / At most: ≥ means that amount or more. ≤ means that amount or less.

def: A letter that stands for a number.
defEs: Una letra que representa un número.
alt: Illustration of Variable: A letter that stands for a number.

def: This much or less. It is the same as ≤.
defEs: Esta cantidad o menos. Es lo mismo que ≤.
alt: Illustration of No more than: This much or less. It is the same as ≤.

def: A rule an answer must follow.
defEs: Una regla que la respuesta debe cumplir.
alt: Illustration of Constraint: A rule an answer must follow.

def: All the values that make the sentence true.
defEs: Todos los valores que hacen verdadera la oración.
alt: Illustration of Solution set: All the values that make the sentence true.
